original.target_description: Psychologist Study 1; broad factors affecting intentions description and p. 28 locator do not identify a unique predictor/outcome structural path.

notes: Unassigned fields are null placeholders. Printed β retained; standardisation is not explicitly stated in the supplied source and is not asserted. Structural-path candidates, section 5.2 p. 28 / Fig. 2 p. 29: benefit to attitude β=0.361, p<0.001; risk to attitude β=−0.192, p<0.001; effort to attitude β=−0.070, p>0.05; effort to intention β=−0.226, p<0.001; attitude to intention β=0.415, p<0.001; norm to intention β=0.201, p<0.001 in prose/Fig. 2, but −.201*** in Table 5; journal pressure to intention β=0.001, p>0.05; repository availability to intention β=0.062, p>0.05. Table 3 also prints correlations, a different test family. No candidates assigned to rows. Candidate common analytic sample: 341 psychologist respondents used for final data analysis (section 4.3, p. 27), after removing responses with more than 10% missing values and 56 non-psychology responses. This candidate N is retained only for parent field-scope review because the target test is unresolved. No N derived from df or summed groups.
